Introduction.SourceString: 尚在扩招中的「柯林斯家族」的一代目。
Introduction.LocalizedString: The Ichi-daime of the Coluccis—currently seeking new recruits!

Content.SourceString:
娜娜莉，桥间地的街头一霸，其（闯祸的）威名可谓无人不知无人不晓。
面对威名远扬的「伊波恩」古董店，娜娜莉从踢馆到被扣押抵债……只需要华丽丽的一个月时间。
打工吧！柯林斯家族的一代目大人！让世界拜服、颤抖于那有力的双拳之下！

任务除外的时间，娜娜莉基本都在为了振兴柯林斯家族而四处游走。
首当其冲的招揽对象，当然是「伊波恩」的人。虽然有一两个笨蛋，但大体上都是些很不错的家伙们。嗯……振兴家族的荣耀，就分他们一份吧。

青花鱼只吃脆脆的，小羊排只吃裹满酱的。
饭后清洁好物可用「蓬绒绒尾巴护理喷雾」，自用无广，爱来自娜娜莉。
饭后消食运动可选「墙体360°跑酷」、「巡逻地盘」、「找个不顺眼的干一架」。比较推荐第一种，安全无风险。
娜娜莉首推的海特洛市最佳观景点，那必须是——喔唷！堂堂家族头目的行踪可不能暴露！
不过娜娜莉倒是提过以前和某个重要的同伴一起看风景，至于是谁……是谁呢……她自己也想不起来了。这就是贵人多忘事吧？

最后，重要的事强调三遍——
娜娜莉，不是猫，是虎！不是猫，是虎！不是虎，是猫……啊呸！不是猫，是虎！
Content.LocalizedString:
Nanally, the queen of Bridge Crossings, whose reputation for causing trouble is known far and wide.
Facing the famous Eibon antique shop, it took Nanally just one glorious month to go from challenging them to being held as collateral for debt.
Work hard, Colucci Family Ichi-daime! Make the world bow and tremble before those mighty fists!

When not on quests, Nanally spends most of her time wandering around trying to revive the Colucci Family.
Her top recruitment targets are obviously the Eibon folks. Sure, there's a dummy or two, but they're pretty decent people overall. Well… they can share in the family's glorious revival.

She's picky about food. Mackerel must be crispy, and lamb chops better come smothered in sauce.
For post-meal cleanup, try Fluffy Tail Care Spray, no ads needed, love from Nanally.
Post-meal exercise options include 360° wall parkour, patrolling territory, or picking a fight with someone. The first one's recommended, safe and risk-free.
Nanally's top pick for best scenic spot in Hethereau is… oh no! A family boss can't reveal her whereabouts!
Though Nanally did mention enjoying some view with an important companion before… but who was it… who was it… she can't remember either. That's what happens when important people forget things, right?

Finally, something important must be said three times:
Nanally is not a cat, she's a tiger! Not a cat, a tiger! Not a tiger, a cat… bah! Not a cat, a tiger!

Content.SourceString:
精心剪裁的虎形瓶盖，托帕石蓝的塑料膜，再加一根坚不可摧的小别针。
如果胆敢小看娜娜莉胸前的徽章，就要做好被噼里啪啦乱拳出击的准备了。
力量、力量源源不断涌现出来了……哼哼，好好感受柯林斯家族的羁绊之力吧！
Content.LocalizedString:
A carefully cut tiger-shaped bottle cap, topaz blue plastic wrap, plus one unbreakable little safety pin.
Anyone who dares to underestimate the badge on Nanally's chest better be ready for a flurry of punches!
Power, power keeps flowing endlessly… Heh heh, feel the bond of the Colucci Family!

Content.SourceString:
娜娜莉小时候最喜欢的帮派动画片——当然，现在也最喜欢。
尤其钟爱第三集12分07秒出现的一只粉色肌肉虎……难以忘怀！那电光火花中屹立不倒的伟岸身姿，就是娜娜莉此生不变的信仰！
如果能和它做朋友就好了，感觉能成为无敌的搭档。
Content.LocalizedString:
Nanally's favorite gang anime when she was a kid... and of course, it's still her favorite now.
She's especially obsessed with the pink muscle tiger that appears at 12:07 in Episode 3… absolutely unforgettable! That towering figure, standing unwavering amidst the sparks and lightning, mirrors Nanally's lifelong creed.
If only she could befriend it… they'd be an unbeatable team.

Content.SourceString:
「不必在乎我的态度，我本就是硬骨头（哼笑）。」——娜娜莉
「拳拳到肉，轰雷掣电！这才是帮派的浪漫（挥拳）！」——娜娜莉
「走这条路……就是不断经历相遇与离别，我懂（叹息）。」——娜娜莉
Content.LocalizedString:
"Don't worry about my attitude, I'm tough as nails (snorts)." - Nanally
"Fist to flesh, thunder and lightning! This is the romance of gang life (throws punch)!" - Nanally
"Walking this path… it means constant encounters and farewells… I understand that (sighs)…" - Nanally

Content.SourceString:
8岁在「噗卡巧脆棒抢夺事件」中，击退贪婪的小胖哥，并使其戒掉甜食，成功减肥逆袭为校园男神。
9岁在「火炬木篮球场侵占事件」中，打跑蛮横的初中生三人组，并用篮球给三楼某家窗户开了一个洞，保证了良好的通风环境。
10岁在「扶老奶奶过马路事件」中，荣获5秒抵达马路对面的好成绩，并使奶奶腿脚迅速康复、健步离开，堪称医学奇迹。
Content.LocalizedString:
At age 8, during the "Puka Crispy Stick Snatching Incident," Nanally defeated a greedy kid and helped him quit sweets. He later lost weight and became the school heartthrob.
At age 9, during the "Torchwood Basketball Court Invasion Incident," she drove off three middle school bullies and opened a hole in a third-floor window with a basketball to improve ventilation.
At age 10, during the "Helping Granny Cross the Street Incident," she achieved the impressive record of only taking 5 seconds from one side of the street to the other. Granny's legs even recovered instantly, and she walked away briskly. What a miracle!

Content.SourceString:
见过倒转后的球形磁场吗？
办公楼是一件摔了个底朝天的裤衩，沿边的树是静电炸毛的老虎尾巴。
太阳被地平线吸附，影子与磁场交叠——欢迎来到未曾显露的新世界。
Content.LocalizedString:
Ever seen a reversed spherical magnetic field?
The office building is like underwear that got flipped upside down, and the trees along the edge are tiger tails all frizzed up from static.
The sun gets stuck to the horizon… shadows overlap with magnetic fields… Welcome to a whole new world that's never been revealed.

Content.SourceString: 新人？在下——不对，咳咳，鄙人呃……我！娜娜莉·柯林斯，是未来全海特洛最伟大的家族——「柯林斯」家族的一代目！今后我会罩着你的。
Content.LocalizedString: Newcomer? I—no, ahem, I mean, I, Nanally Coluccis, am the Ichi-daime of the future greatest family in all of Hethereau—the Colucci family! I'll have your back from now on.

Content.SourceString: 没什么事做的话，要不要听听我的家族兴建大计？
Content.LocalizedString: If you've got nothing to …do, want to hear my grand plan for the family?

Content.SourceString: 好没劲啊……嗯？！我闻到了阴谋的味道。轮到我出动了？
Content.LocalizedString:
Argh, I'm so bored… Hmm?! Something
doesn't feel quite right. I should probably
scram…

Content.SourceString: 《家族管理学》序章，首先……唔！！！
Content.LocalizedString: Family Management… huh… Prologue… first of all… Ugh!!!

Content.SourceString: 晴空万里！……为什么要用那种欣慰的眼神看我？
Content.LocalizedString: Clear skies! …Why are you looking at me like a pleased mother?

Content.SourceString: 好大的雨……好！就这样直接冲回去吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Boy, the rain is crazy… Alright, let's surf our way back!

Content.SourceString: 好~冷~啊~~~快动起来吧，我要变成冰棍了！
Content.LocalizedString: It's so cold! Hurry up. I'm turning into a popsicle!

Content.SourceString: 我现在就好像海滩上的鱼，如果有一块碎雪冰淇淋的话……
Content.LocalizedString: I feel like a fish on the beach right now. If only I had a Blizzi ice cream…

Content.SourceString: 早上好！有新的委托吗？柯林斯家族随时可以出发！
Content.LocalizedString: Good morning! Any new commissions? The Coluccis are always good to go!

Content.SourceString: 午餐时间！今天有我喜欢的芝士蛋卷吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Lunchtime! Is my favorite cheesy eggroll on the menu today?

Content.SourceString: 还早还早，再出去转一趟吧。
Content.LocalizedString: It's still early. Let's go out for another round.

Content.SourceString: 诶？已经这个点了吗？打完这局就睡！
Content.LocalizedString: Huh? Is it this late already? One more game and I'm going to sleep!

Content.SourceString: 零食、漫画、游戏机、抓虫子、跑酷、揍小弟，还有……太多了根本数不过来。
Content.LocalizedString: Snacks, manga, gaming, bug catching, parkour, beating up minions, and… argh, I've lost count.

Content.SourceString: 烦恼？嗯……呃……我知道了！我放在冰箱里的最后一个珍藏布丁不知道被谁吃掉了。可恶，那可是我特意留着，打算看最新一期《月刊Fantasy》的时候好好享受的呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Worry? Hmm… Uh… I know! Someone ate the pudding I left in the fridge. I was totally looking forward to enjoying it while reading the latest issue of "Monthly Fantasy".

Content.SourceString: 不和家族站在一起的老大，不算是真正的老大……家族事业就是我们的根基，背叛家族就是背叛自己！……怎么样，帅吧？《罪城往事》的这几句台词我想说很久了！
Content.LocalizedString: A boss who doesn't stand by their family is not a real boss… We owe everything to the family business for who we are today. Betraying the family is betraying yourself! …How's that? Cool, right? I've always wanted to say these lines from "Sin City Chronicles"!

Content.SourceString: 先「噼啪——」一下，然后再「啪嚓——」一下，就可以吸在墙上倒过来啦！而且而且，这样「唰——」的一下出现在反派面前，可是我的独家登场方式！
Content.LocalizedString: First a crackle-POP, then a snap-ZAP, and bam—I'm upside down and clinging to the wall! Oh, oh! And when I go whoosh and drop in right in front of the bad guys? That's my signature entrance!

Content.SourceString: 先用清水打湿毛发，再用专门的洗剂清洗，然后用柔风吹到半干上「蓬绒绒尾巴护理喷雾」，再换成冷风吹干，最后再修剪掉分叉和多余的毛发。这些都是大叔教我的，毕竟一代目的形象对于家族来说可是很重要的。
Content.LocalizedString: First, rinse the fur with clean water. Then use the special cleanser, blow-dry with warm air until it's fluffy-but-damp, spritz on some conditioners, switch to cool air to finish drying, and trim off any split ends. That's how Adler taught me—after all, the Ichi-daime has to look the part!

Content.SourceString: 为了找回遗失的家族信物，我一个箭步爬到楼栋的外界管道上！结果没想到有歹人想害我，居然在那放了根待维修的电缆线——我只感觉身体一麻，不受控制地掉下去……咦？好像有谁拉了我一把？然后身体里「噼里啪啦」的，我们就一起站在墙面上了！至于代价......好像没什么感觉，大概小得可以忽略不计吧，难道这就是主角光环？
Content.LocalizedString: To get back the family heirloom, I leapt onto the outer pipes of the building! But then—get this—some creep set up a broken live cable just waiting for me. I felt this ZZZZZT jolt and then I was falling! But I swear someone grabbed me! Next thing I know, my body's all spark-crackle, and we're just standing there—on the wall! As for the price… hmm… didn't feel anything weird. Maybe the cost was too small to notice? Is this what they call… plot armor?

Content.SourceString: 这个伤口好像是异象干的，这里好像是为了帮街口的奶奶抓偷吃的团三郎，撞到了消防栓上……啊，这个伤口我记得，是为了好好教训那些抢劫的混混。都是小伤啦，跟挠痒痒一样！……诶？衣服哪里有洞？完了完了，又要麻烦大叔了！
Content.LocalizedString: This wound's probably from an anomaly. This one is from bumping into a fire hydrant when I chased Danzaburou after it stole food from a grandma… Ah, and this is from teaching those robbers a good lesson. All minor injuries, doesn't hurt one bit! …Huh? Holes on my clothes?! Ahhh… guess I'm in trouble with the old man…

Content.SourceString: 可不是我吹牛，在我进伊波恩之前，蓝胡子路和火炬木大道那边，哪个道上的家伙不知道我娜娜莉的威名！就算没有异能的时候，那些家伙也完全——不是我的对手。……打听？打、打听就不用了吧，咳，要是给伊波恩惹来以前的仇家可就不好了！
Content.LocalizedString: Not trying to brag or anything, but before I joined Eibon, everyone on Bluebeard Road and Torchwood Avenue knew who I was! I didn't even need to fight them with my Esper Ability… Uh, what? Did you just say you wanted to learn more about me? Thanks but no thanks. I don't want no trouble around Eibon!

Content.SourceString: 身世成谜，深藏不漏的古董店店长，听起来实在是……太酷了！好想成为像大姐头这样的人，是要从喝酒学起吗？
Content.LocalizedString: A mysterious antique shop owner with an enigmatic background sounds so cool! I really want to be like her. Should I start by learning to drink?

Content.SourceString: 你说怎么会有大叔这么全能的人，好像就从来没有他做不到的事情。大姐头喝多了的时候，我悄悄去问过好几次到底是哪里挖来的大叔，听过什么厨师改行、猎人再就业，好多好多个不同的版本……早雾说我被骗了，果然这样的人才属于高级商业机密吗！
Content.LocalizedString: There is nothing old man can't do, can you believe it? I've tried to dig for secrets a few times when Boss was drunk, and all I got was all sorts of rumors… except Sakiri said none of those was true. Boy, is the guy some sort of trade secret?

Content.SourceString: 总觉得早雾她……她有很多事情都藏在心里。不过我作为老大，对家族的人都是很包容的，早雾继续做早雾就好了。如果有一天我变得像达芙蒂尔师父那么强了，说不定早雾就什么都愿意告诉我了呢！
Content.LocalizedString: It seems like Sakiri… keeps a whole lot of things to herself. But as the leader, I'm very tolerant of my family members. Sakiri can continue being herself. I mean, she might just open up to me someday when I'm as powerful as Master Daffodill!

Content.SourceString: 埃德嘉的脑子里好像装了一台电脑，就连「为什么圆形披萨装在方形盒子里，然后切成三角形」「为什么薯片袋子里的空气比薯片多」这样的问题都回答得上来！电器头的造型留给塔吉多也太浪费了，依我看应该给埃德嘉。
Content.LocalizedString: There seems to be a computer in Edgar's head. He can even answer bizarre questions like "Why are round pizzas put in square boxes and then cut into triangles?" or "Why is there more air than chips in a bag of chips?" Honestly, they should have designed Edgar's head the way they have Taygedo's.

Content.SourceString: 没见过比达芙蒂尔师父的作息还要规律的人！她还从来不偷懒！连刷牙和吃饭这么令人放松的时候，背都挺得笔直笔直的！还有她训练的时候，从来都不中场休息……呃，是我路过刚好看到的，绝对不是偷看啊！我、我坦坦荡荡！
Content.LocalizedString: I've never seen anyone with a more regular routine than Master Daffodill! She never slacks off! I mean, she even brushes her teeth and eats with her back straight! And when she trains, she never takes a break… Uh, I just happened to see it while passing by. I wasn't peeking! I swear!

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多？还在考察期。看他表现，要是他乖乖听话的话，哼哼，以后也不是不能提拔成家族干部。跟着我，他算是出人头地了！
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo? He's still on probation, but if he does as I say, I just might consider giving him an important role in the family down the road. He really needs to consider himself lucky working for me!

Content.SourceString: 冷清小巷里的神秘店铺，捉摸不透的神秘店长，武力值超高的冷酷保镖，万能的机器人式管家，还有……的吉祥物！怎么看都是热血漫画标配的设定啊！虽然加入伊波恩后，这里的生活和我想象的有点不同……但是！我已经闻到主线的气息了，伊波恩和柯林斯家族的名号迟早会响彻整个海特洛，哦不，整个世界！
Content.LocalizedString: A mysterious shop in a quiet alley, an enigmatic shop owner, a high-combat-value cold bodyguard, a versatile robot-like butler, and… a mascot! It looks like a setting straight out of a hot-blooded manga! I mean, life at Eibon turned out different than I'd imagined… but I can already smell the plot brewing! People all over Hethereau are going to know Eibon and the Coluccis. No, people all over the world are going to know Eibon and the Coluccis!

Content.SourceString: 这才是一代目的样子。
Content.LocalizedString: This is Nanally Colucci for you.

Content.SourceString: 新的招式！
Content.LocalizedString: New move!

Content.SourceString: 是时候解封我无上的力量了~
Content.LocalizedString: Time to show you my ultimate power!

Content.SourceString: 我敢保证！没有——比它——更好的了！
Content.LocalizedString: I swear, nothing can ever—beat—this!

Content.SourceString: 这东西……你真舍得？！我果然没看错你！
Content.LocalizedString: A gift like this… Are you sure? I I knew you wouldn't let me down!

Content.SourceString: 哪儿找来的战利品~
Content.LocalizedString: Where did you get spoils like this?

Content.SourceString: 说吧，什么事有求于本老大？
Content.LocalizedString: Alright then, let this Ichi-daime know what you need.

Content.SourceString: 嗷呜!
Content.LocalizedString: Mrrrowr!

Content.SourceString: 来点惊喜！
Content.LocalizedString: Surprise!

Content.SourceString: 看我厉害！
Content.LocalizedString: Watch me shine!

Content.SourceString: 一招！全城制霸！
Content.LocalizedString: Take that! The city's mine!

Content.SourceString: 全体！听我指挥！
Content.LocalizedString: Everyone! Follow my command!

Content.SourceString: 「副手」，该我们救场了！
Content.LocalizedString: Underboss, it's our turn!

Content.SourceString: 勉为其难~把你收作小弟好了！
Content.LocalizedString: Well well well… The Colucci Family is always looking for new members like you!

Content.SourceString: 以后要和大家好好相处！
Content.LocalizedString: Get along with everyone from now on!

Content.SourceString: 收工！……呃，损坏物品的账单可以不寄到伊波恩吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Job done! …Uh, can the bill for damages be sent elsewhere?

Content.SourceString: 总算结束！
Content.LocalizedString: It's finally over!

Content.SourceString: 好东西！快收起来快收起来！
Content.LocalizedString: Great stuff! Better hide it!

Content.SourceString: 很好很好，家族又可以壮大了。
Content.LocalizedString: Very good, the family shall grow stronger.

Content.SourceString: 这个能拿去给大姐头还债吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Can this be used to pay off the Boss's debt?

Content.SourceString: 欸欸，这个得偷偷藏好！
Content.LocalizedString: Woah, I gotta hide this!

Content.SourceString: 别急，待我回去研究一下！
Content.LocalizedString: Hold on, I'll look into this when we get back!

Content.SourceString: 噢噢噢——我知道这个！这个是、这个是……
Content.LocalizedString: Oooh! I know this! It… it's…

Content.SourceString: 切，我还有更厉害的招式呢！
Content.LocalizedString: Tch, I've got even better moves!

Content.SourceString: 好痛……没被人看到吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Ouch… hope no one saw that?

Content.SourceString: 咳咳，英雄落幕前……
Content.LocalizedString: Cough cough… before this hero's final moments…

Content.SourceString: 哼哼，现在是我的回合！
Content.LocalizedString: Heh, now it's my turn!

Content.SourceString: 状态绝佳！
Content.LocalizedString: Ready to go!

Content.SourceString: 给柯林斯……丢脸了……
Content.LocalizedString: Brought shame… to the Coluccis…

Content.SourceString: 我不是个……称职的老大……
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not… a competent boss…

Content.SourceString: 这样……一点都不酷……
Content.LocalizedString: This… isn't cool at all…

Content.SourceString: 下一个！
Content.LocalizedString: Next!

Content.SourceString: 下次记得早点求饶！
Content.LocalizedString: Beg for mercy earlier next time.

Content.SourceString: 热身而已！
Content.LocalizedString: Just warming up!

Content.SourceString: 挠痒痒一样！
Content.LocalizedString: Just a tickle!

Content.SourceString: 还挺嚣张！
Content.LocalizedString: Quite arrogant!

Content.SourceString: 谁搞偷袭！
Content.LocalizedString: No hitting from the back!

Content.SourceString: 有事我来摆平！
Content.LocalizedString: I'll handle this!

Content.SourceString: 早就该到我了嘛！
Content.LocalizedString: It should've been my turn ages ago!

Content.SourceString: 闪亮登场！
Content.LocalizedString: Time to shine!

Content.SourceString: 你惹了不该惹的人！
Content.LocalizedString: You picked a fight with the wrong person!

Content.SourceString: 吃我一拳！
Content.LocalizedString: Eat this!

Content.SourceString: ……什么味道，好香啊~
Content.LocalizedString: What's that smell? Smells amazing!

Content.SourceString: 呜呼，自由如风——
Content.LocalizedString: Whoo! As free as the wind!

Content.SourceString: 放心包在我身上，这次绝对不闯祸！
Content.LocalizedString: Leave this to me! I won't mess up this time!

Content.SourceString: 大叔休息，我来接手！
Content.LocalizedString: Take a break, old man! I'll handle this!

Content.SourceString: 让他们见识下柯林斯家族的羁绊！
Content.LocalizedString: Let them witness the bond of the Coluccis!

Content.SourceString: 教你一句话：名师出高徒！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm gonna show you how a great teacher makes a great student!

Content.SourceString: 有事怎么不喊你老大？
Content.LocalizedString: Why didn't you call your boss when you needed help?

Content.SourceString: 风驰完了，就该电掣！
Content.LocalizedString: Move like wind, strike like thunder!

Content.SourceString: 不要小看我和鉴定师热血沸腾的组合技啊！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't underestimate my wombo-combo with the Appraiser!

Content.SourceString: 你这家伙对大姐头做了什么——！
Content.LocalizedString: What did you do to the Boss?!

Content.SourceString: 不会原谅……！
Content.LocalizedString: I'll never forget this…!

Content.SourceString: 谁允许你对柯林斯骨干出手了？
Content.LocalizedString: Who gave you permission to lay hands on one of mine?

Content.SourceString: 绝不会让师父失望。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll never let Master down.

Content.SourceString: 不许——踩她——尾巴——
Content.LocalizedString: DON'T—STEP—ON—HER—TAIL!

Content.SourceString: 还没到认输的时候！
Content.LocalizedString: It's not time to give up!

Content.SourceString: 谁敢伤害柯林斯最重要的骨干成员——
Content.LocalizedString: Who dares to hurt a core Colucci member!?

Content.SourceString: 哼，雕虫小技。
Content.LocalizedString: Heh, child's play.

Content.SourceString: 我挡~
Content.LocalizedString: I block!

Content.SourceString: 和我比身手？
Content.LocalizedString: Think you can challenge me?

Content.SourceString: 太慢了太慢了~
Content.LocalizedString: Can't touch this!
